comment: Labelled eval pairs for the #918 semantic convergence layer. 'converge' pairs must link at cosineThreshold 0.8 with a real multilingual model; 'distinct' pairs must NOT. The end-to-end fixture test runs ONLY when an embedding backend is available (AEE_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH + @xenova/transformers installed) and skips cleanly otherwise; threshold changes must keep this green. The pure-logic tests use synthetic vectors and always run.

pairs.label: converge
pairs.a: Der Build schlägt fehl, wenn npm install hinter dem Proxy läuft — vorher HTTP_PROXY setzen
pairs.b: The build fails when npm install runs behind the proxy — set HTTP_PROXY first

pairs.label: converge
pairs.a: Branches immer von origin/main abzweigen, niemals von lokalen Ständen
pairs.b: Always branch from origin/main, never from local state

pairs.label: converge
pairs.a: Retries against the poller must be capped or an endless notification storm results
pairs.b: Unbounded re-polling loops flood the event queue with duplicate wake-ups

pairs.label: converge

pairs.b: Job Control Language jobs require the REGION parameter, otherwise they abnormally end with system code S822
